nodes.summary: The vector `α̂ = Xᵀ y / N` of marginal correlations between the (standardized) markers and the phenotype.
nodes.title: Marginal marker-phenotype correlations in SLDP regression

nodes.summary: SLDP first-moment identity (Reshef et al. 2018, Methods, Equation 5): if the true effects have mean `μ v`, then `𝔼 α̂ = μ R̂ v`, a multiple of the signed LD profile `R̂ v` of `v`.
nodes.title: SLDP first-moment identity

nodes.summary: Conditional on the genotype matrix, `𝔼 α̂ = R̂ 𝔼 β` with `R̂ = Xᵀ X / N`.
nodes.title: First-moment identity, exact in-sample form

nodes.summary: Unbiasedness with covariates (the signed background model): suppose the true effects have mean `μ v + U γ` for background annotations `U` (columns `u_b`) with arbitrary coefficients `γ`, let `A = R̂ U` be their signed LD profiles, and let `z⊥ = R̂ v - A w` be the weighted residual of the signed LD profile of `v` on `A` (`Aᵀ W z⊥ = 0`) for a symmetric weight matrix `W`. If `⟪z⊥, z⊥⟫_W ≠ 0`, then…
nodes.title: Unbiasedness with covariates

nodes.summary: For any weight matrix `W` and signed LD profile `s = R̂ v` with `⟪s, s⟫_W = sᵀ W s ≠ 0`, if `𝔼 β = μ v` then `𝔼 [⟪s, α̂⟫_W / ⟪s, s⟫_W] = μ`, where `⟪a, b⟫_W = aᵀ W b`. SLDP uses the inverse of `Ω = σ² R² + R / N` as `W`.
nodes.title: Unbiasedness of the weighted least-squares estimator

nodes.summary: The in-sample LD matrix `R̂ = Xᵀ X / N`, with entries `ldCorr X j k`.
nodes.title: In-sample LD matrix

nodes.summary: The linear phenotype model of SLDP regression at the level of first moments: integrable random effects `β` with means `meanBeta` and integrable noise `ε` of mean zero. (SLDP's model takes `meanBeta = μ v` for a signed annotation `v`; second moments are not needed for the first-moment identity.)
nodes.title: First-moment phenotype model of SLDP regression

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
